hero.title: INZUMER
hero.tagline: Senior Frontend Engineer — or Nahuel Zamuner, if you prefer.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I build fast, accessible interfaces for products used by millions. Today I lead the frontend architecture of PortAventura World's digital ecosystem at Randstad Digital: React and TypeScript apps that run in WebViews and hold up under seasonal traffic peaks.

Before that I spent over three years in the checkout of Mercado Libre, one of the largest e-commerce platforms in the world. I care about Core Web Vitals, design systems and tests that catch regressions before people do, and I maintain Inzumer, my own design system: components, tokens and emails published on npm.

items.title: Fast interfaces
items.text: Core Web Vitals in the green and instant loads, even during seasonal traffic peaks.

items.title: Apps in WebViews
items.text: One web codebase running as an app on iOS and Android, with safe areas, gestures and focus taken care of.

items.title: Design systems
items.text: Components, tokens and Storybook docs so several teams build the same way.

items.title: Accessibility
items.text: WCAG 2.2 AA from the first component: keyboard, screen readers and contrast.

items.title: Testing and quality
items.text: Unit, integration and end-to-end tests that catch regressions before every release.

items.title: Frontend architecture
items.text: Technical standards, code reviews and mentoring so the codebase scales with the team.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
ecosystem.intro: Every project I start stands on the same base: a design system, tokens, emails, docs and CI that I maintain as packages. A new product gets accessibility, tests and releases from day one, and the base can move to any team that needs it.

ai.title: AI with rules
ai.text: I work with AI agents every day, and every repo tells them how: guides with the conventions, specialized agents and the same checks a person goes through. AI speeds up the work; the standards and the final review stay with me.
points: Agent guides in every repo, shared like the rest of the code.
The same rules for people and agents: tests, accessibility and clean code.
Quality gates on every change: 90% coverage, WCAG 2.2 AA audits and zero known vulnerabilities.
Human review before anything reaches production.

pieces.name: UI library
pieces.text: React components with accessibility built in, ready for the web and for apps in WebViews, documented in Storybook.

pieces.name: Tokens
pieces.text: Colors, type, spacing and themes in one package that feeds the components, the emails and the docs.

pieces.name: Emails
pieces.text: React email templates that render in every client, each brand with its own theme.

pieces.name: Docs
pieces.text: One site that documents every package and reads well on a phone.

pieces.name: CI
pieces.text: Shared GitHub workflows: tests with coverage, security, duplication, accessibility and releases.

pieces.name: Configs
pieces.text: ESLint, Prettier and TypeScript set once and reused, so every repo is written the same way.
